text:
Maya: Anyone up for a retro-console swap + mini-arcade corner Friday afternoon? Thinking SNES/Sega/N64 carts, old controllers, classic chaos.
Connor: YES. I have a Super EverDrive and a box of cartridges. can bring Mario Kart 64 and GoldenEye for nostalgia damage.
Ravi: i'm in. also i can bring my CRT-ish HDMI scaler and a small CRT if we want authentic fuzz.pls say yes.
Lina: can we also do a controller lending post? i only have USB modern controllers but would love to try an N64 rumble pack.
Maya: great call. let's do a controller sign-out sheet. quick poll: react with emoji to say what you'll bring: :tv: = display (projector/TV), :cart: = cartridges/carts, :pad: = controllers, :snack: = snacks/drinks
Connor: :cart: :pad:
Ravi: :tv: :cart:
Lina: :pad: :snack:
Maya: :snack: (i'll bring chips + vegan option)
ops-bot: Room reservation: Commons B, 15:30-18:00 on 2026-03-28. Organizer: Maya.
Connor: Schedule idea: 15:30 setup, 16:00 freeplay, 17:00 bracket for 8 players (tiny, single-elim), 17:45 wrap + best-kill-screen screenshot contest.
Ravi: for brackets, can we do a seeded randomizer? i'm terrible at seeding but enjoy chaos.
Maya: seeded by who brings snacks? jk. we'll do a quick random draw.
Lina: controller etiquette: clean on return pls. i'll bring sanitizing wipes and a lil ziplock for loose sticks.
Connor: also heads up: if anyone wants to run local netplay for SNES I can host via RetroArch netplay. bring ethernet or hot-spot.
Maya: ok sign-up list (just copy/paste what you're bringing in thread):
Connor: Bringing: EverDrive + carts (Mario Kart 64, GoldenEye, Smash 64), 2 N64 controllers
Ravi: Bringing: small CRT + HDMI scaler, power strip, CRT stand
Lina: Bringing: 3 modern USB pads, sanitizing wipes, soda (no sugar option)
Maya: Bringing: chips (vegan + regular), folding table, clipboard for sign-out
Ravi: tiny tech note: CRT scaler sometimes needs 720p passthrough, use `xrandr --output HDMI-1 --mode 720x480` on linux laptops if needed.
Lina: also pro tip: bring rechargeable AAs for wireless N64 adapters, they eat batteries.
Connor: i'm hyped. who wants to be MC for the bracket? i'll provide a tiny victory ribbon.
Maya: i'll MC and take photos. winners get glory + ribbon + honorary snack crown :crown:
Lina: count me in. see y'all Friday! :video_game:
